framework.name: ISO/IEC 27001
framework.description: Information security management system (ISMS) standard; Annex A defines 93 reference controls across 4 themes.

controls.title: Policies for information security
controls.description: Maintain top-level information security policy, approved and communicated.

controls.title: Information security roles and responsibilities
controls.description: Define and assign security roles/responsibilities across the organization.

controls.title: Segregation of duties
controls.description: Separate conflicting duties/responsibilities to reduce misuse risk.

controls.title: Management responsibilities
controls.description: Management actively requires staff to follow established security practices.

controls.title: Contact with authorities
controls.description: Maintain appropriate contact with relevant authorities (law enforcement, regulators).

controls.title: Contact with special interest groups
controls.description: Maintain contact with security forums/groups for threat and practice awareness.

controls.title: Threat intelligence
controls.description: Collect and analyze threat information to inform mitigation actions.

controls.title: Information security in project management
controls.description: Integrate security considerations into project management processes.

controls.title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
controls.description: Maintain an inventory of information assets and their owners.

controls.title: Acceptable use of information and other associated assets
controls.description: Define and communicate rules for acceptable use/handling of assets.

controls.title: Return of assets
controls.description: Ensure assets are returned when employment/engagement ends.

controls.title: Classification of information
controls.description: Classify information according to confidentiality/integrity/availability needs.

controls.title: Labelling of information
controls.description: Label information consistently with its classification scheme.

controls.title: Information transfer
controls.description: Apply rules/agreements/controls to information transfer (internal, external, physical).

controls.title: Access control
controls.description: Establish rules controlling physical/logical access based on business need.

controls.title: Identity management
controls.description: Manage the full lifecycle of identities used across systems.

controls.title: Authentication information
controls.description: Manage allocation and protection of authentication information (e.g. credentials).

controls.title: Access rights
controls.description: Provision, review, and revoke access rights per policy and role changes.

controls.title: Information security in supplier relationships
controls.description: Define security requirements for engaging with suppliers.

controls.title: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
controls.description: Embed relevant security requirements into supplier contracts.

controls.title: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
controls.description: Manage security risk across the ICT product/service supply chain.

controls.title: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
controls.description: Track supplier service delivery and manage changes to it.

controls.title: Information security for use of cloud services
controls.description: Define processes for acquiring, using, and exiting cloud services securely.

controls.title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
controls.description: Plan roles, processes, and procedures ahead of security incidents.

controls.title: Assessment and decision on information security events
controls.description: Assess security events to decide whether they are incidents.

controls.title: Response to information security incidents
controls.description: Respond to incidents per documented procedures.

controls.title: Learning from information security incidents
controls.description: Use incident knowledge to reduce likelihood/impact of future incidents.

controls.title: Collection of evidence
controls.description: Define procedures for identifying, collecting, and preserving evidence.

controls.title: Information security during disruption
controls.description: Maintain security continuity during disruptive events.

controls.title: ICT readiness for business continuity
controls.description: Plan/test ICT readiness to support business continuity objectives.

controls.title: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
controls.description: Identify and meet applicable legal/regulatory/contractual security requirements.

controls.title: Intellectual property rights
controls.description: Protect intellectual property rights in line with legal/contractual obligations.

controls.title: Protection of records
controls.description: Protect records from loss, destruction, falsification, and unauthorized access.

controls.title: Privacy and protection of PII
controls.description: Identify and meet privacy/PII protection requirements.

controls.title: Independent review of information security
controls.description: Periodically review the security approach independently of those it governs.

controls.title: Compliance with policies, rules and standards for information security
controls.description: Regularly verify compliance with internal security policy/standards.

controls.title: Documented operating procedures
controls.description: Document and make available operating procedures for information processing.

controls.title: Screening
controls.description: Screen candidates before employment, proportional to role risk.

controls.title: Terms and conditions of employment
controls.description: State security responsibilities in employment terms/agreements.

controls.title: Information security awareness, education and training
controls.description: Provide ongoing security awareness/training appropriate to role.

controls.title: Disciplinary process
controls.description: Have a formal, communicated process for security policy violations.

controls.title: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
controls.description: Define security duties/obligations that persist after role changes or exit.

controls.title: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
controls.description: Use confidentiality agreements reflecting organizational protection needs.

controls.title: Remote working
controls.description: Apply security measures protecting information accessed/processed remotely.

controls.title: Information security event reporting
controls.description: Provide a mechanism for personnel to report observed/suspected security events.

controls.title: Physical security perimeters
controls.description: Define and protect physical perimeters around sensitive areas.

controls.title: Physical entry
controls.description: Control physical entry to secure areas appropriate to sensitivity.

controls.title: Securing offices, rooms and facilities
controls.description: Design and secure physical work areas holding information assets.

controls.title: Physical security monitoring
controls.description: Continuously monitor premises for unauthorized physical access.

controls.title: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
controls.description: Design protection against natural/environmental/man-made physical threats.

controls.title: Working in secure areas
controls.description: Apply measures for personnel working within designated secure areas.

controls.title: Clear desk and clear screen
controls.description: Enforce clear desk/clear screen rules for sensitive information.

controls.title: Equipment siting and protection
controls.description: Site and protect equipment to reduce environmental/access risks.

controls.title: Security of assets off-premises
controls.description: Protect assets used or stored outside organizational premises.

controls.title: Storage media
controls.description: Manage storage media through its lifecycle per classification.

controls.title: Supporting utilities
controls.description: Protect equipment from utility failures (power, cooling, etc.).

controls.title: Cabling security
controls.description: Protect power/data cabling from interception, damage, or interference.

controls.title: Equipment maintenance
controls.description: Maintain equipment correctly to preserve availability/integrity.

controls.title: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
controls.description: Verify sensitive data/licensed software is removed before disposal/reuse.

controls.title: User endpoint devices
controls.description: Protect information on/accessed via user endpoint devices.

controls.title: Privileged access rights
controls.description: Restrict and manage privileged access rights tightly.

controls.title: Information access restriction
controls.description: Restrict access to information/functions per access control policy.

controls.title: Access to source code
controls.description: Manage read/write access to source code and related artifacts.

controls.title: Secure authentication
controls.description: Implement secure authentication technologies/procedures.

controls.title: Capacity management
controls.description: Monitor and forecast resource capacity to meet performance requirements.

controls.title: Protection against malware
controls.description: Implement detection/prevention/recovery controls against malware.

controls.title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.description: Identify, evaluate, and remediate technical vulnerabilities timely.

controls.title: Configuration management
controls.description: Define, document, and monitor secure configurations for systems.

controls.title: Information deletion
controls.description: Delete information when no longer required, per policy/legal need.

controls.title: Data masking
controls.description: Mask data to limit exposure of sensitive information, incl. PII.

controls.title: Data leakage prevention
controls.description: Apply measures to detect/prevent unauthorized disclosure of data.

controls.title: Information backup
controls.description: Maintain and test backups per business/continuity requirements.

controls.title: Redundancy of information processing facilities
controls.description: Provide redundancy sufficient to meet availability requirements.

controls.title: Logging
controls.description: Produce, retain, and protect logs of events, exceptions, and faults.

controls.title: Monitoring activities
controls.description: Monitor systems/networks for anomalous behavior.

controls.title: Clock synchronization
controls.description: Synchronize clocks across systems to a single reference time.

controls.title: Use of privileged utility programs
controls.description: Restrict/control use of utilities that could override system controls.

controls.title: Installation of software on operational systems
controls.description: Control software installation on production/operational systems.

controls.title: Networks security
controls.description: Secure, manage, and control networks and network devices.

controls.title: Security of network services
controls.description: Identify and include security features/levels in network service agreements.

controls.title: Segregation of networks
controls.description: Segregate groups of information services/users/systems on networks.

controls.title: Web filtering
controls.description: Manage access to external websites to reduce exposure to malicious content.

controls.title: Use of cryptography
controls.description: Define and apply rules for effective use of cryptography.

controls.title: Secure development life cycle
controls.description: Apply security rules throughout the software/system development lifecycle.

controls.title: Application security requirements
controls.description: Identify/specify security requirements when developing/acquiring applications.

controls.title: Secure system architecture and engineering principles
controls.description: Apply secure engineering principles when building information systems.

controls.title: Secure coding
controls.description: Apply secure coding principles to software development.

controls.title: Security testing in development and acceptance
controls.description: Define and run security testing processes across the development lifecycle.

controls.title: Outsourced development
controls.description: Direct, monitor, and review outsourced system development activity.

controls.title: Separation of development, test and production environments
controls.description: Separate dev/test/production environments to reduce unauthorized change/access risk.

controls.title: Change management
controls.description: Control changes to information processing facilities/systems through a formal process.

controls.title: Test information
controls.description: Select, protect, and manage test information appropriately.

controls.title: Protection of information systems during audit testing
controls.description: Plan/agree audit tests involving operational systems to minimize disruption.

_notes.guidanceUrlPattern: https://www.iso.org/standard/27001 (no free per-control pages published by ISO; use standard landing page for all controls)
